overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Phishing simulations for your own people, training for whoever clicks, and the records audits ask for.
overview.setup: A few steps before your first campaign
overview.setupDetail: Verify a domain you own, set your SMTP relay under Connections, and add people. Awareness mails only your own verified domains, through your own relay.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Each campaign sends a clearly-labelled simulation to your people and records who clicked or reported. Every campaign names an admin and is audited.
campaigns.newDetail: A built-in simulation template, sent from one of your verified domains through your relay.
campaigns.name: Name
campaigns.noneDetail: Create a campaign to send your first simulation.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: A recipient is only ever mailed when its address is in a domain you have proven with a DNS TXT record. Nothing else can be reached.
domains.addDetail: Awareness gives you a token to publish in the domain's DNS, then you verify it.
domains.name: Name
domains.publish: Publish this TXT record, then verify
domains.thenVerify: DNS can take a few minutes to show it. Then press Verify.
domains.noneDetail: Add a domain your organisation owns to start.

people.title: People
people.description: Your own people, from the Identity directory or a CSV import. Addresses outside your verified domains are left out.
people.importDetail: A CSV with an email column, and optional name and department columns.
people.name: Name
people.imported: Imported: {{added}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{rejected}} outside a verified domain and left out.
people.noneDetail: Import a CSV or connect Identity under Connections.

training.title: Training
training.description: Short modules with a quiz. Whoever clicks a simulation is assigned the phishing module; completion becomes compliance evidence.
training.modulesDetail: The built-in modules people are assigned.
training.noneDetail: Training is assigned automatically when someone clicks a simulation.

risk.title: Risk
risk.description: How each person and each team is doing over time: clicks raise risk, reporting and finished training lower it.
risk.timelineDetail: Click and report rate per campaign, oldest first.
risk.noneDetail: Numbers show once you have people and a campaign.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: The SMTP relay Awareness sends through, and the Identity directory it reads people from. Both secrets are sealed with the install's key.
connections.smtpNone: No relay set. Awareness sends no mail until one is.

auditPage.description: Campaigns, domain changes, directory syncs and setting changes. Entries are never changed or removed.

settingsPage.askAnAdmin: Ask an admin of this Awareness.

account.title: Account
account.description: Your profile, password, two-step verification and where you are signed in.

members.title: Members
members.description: Who can sign in to this Awareness, and with which role. Viewers see everything; editors also add domains, import people and run campaigns; admins also connect the relay and Identity, delete domains and read the audit log.

signin.title: Sign-in
signin.description: Identity providers people can sign in with, such as OpenAsy Identity, Keycloak or Microsoft Entra ID, and which of their groups give which role.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: For scripts and CI. Each token has one role and an expiry; the secret is shown once.
